evals.prompt: Review the texts and navigation of our German B2B site https://example.de. Audiences are managing directors, employees and IT partners.
evals.expected_output: Should walk key tasks per audience as a first-time visitor without submitting, apply heuristics, run a five-second test at desktop and mobile, check CTA labels and navigation, and read all text for real errors, term consistency, du/Sie consistency, German typography, long sentences and noun style. Should separate defects from suggestions, quote exact text, and add a term list.
assertions: Quotes the exact text in findings
